It is an {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} and its former rank was prefectural shrine. {{nihongo|'''Hishikino Shrine'''|比自岐神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Iga Province]].

== Origin ==
The founding era is unknown. Its principal deity Hijiki-no-Kami is the ancestral deity of the powerful Hijiki clan, and the clan had close ties to the court, including marrying a Hijiki clan daughter to Prince Maruhi, son of {{ill|Emperor Suinin|ar|الإمبراطور سوينين|arz|الامبراطور سوينين|azb|سوینین (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Suinin|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر سوینین|cs|Suinin|de|Suinin|eo|Suinin|es|Suinin Tennō|fa|امپراتور سوینین|fi|Suinin|fr|Suinin|hr|Suinin|id|Kaisar Suinin|it|Suinin|ja|垂仁天皇|ka|სუინინი|ko|스이닌 천황|lt|Imperatorius Suininas|mn|Эзэн Хаан Сүйнин|nl|Suinin|pl|Suinin|pt|Suinin|ru|Император Суйнин|sh|Car Suinin|simple|Emperor Suinin|sl|Cesar Sujnin|sr|Суинин|sv|Suinin|th|จักรพรรดิซูอินิง|tl|Emperador Suinin|tr|Suinin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Суйнін|uz|Imperator Suinin|vi|Thiên hoàng Suinin|yo|Emperor Suinin|zh|垂仁天皇|zh_min_nan|Suinin Thian-hông|zh_yue|垂仁天皇|qid=Q314850}}. In {{ill|1909|Q2057|qid=Q2057}} (Meiji 41), 33 shrines in former Hijiki village were {{ill|Co-Enshrinement|Q11412524|qid=Q11412524}} into this shrine. In {{ill|1924|Q2173|qid=Q2173}} (Taishō 13), it was promoted to prefectural shrine<ref>{{Cite web|title=三重県神社庁 比自岐神社|url=http://kyoka.mie-jinjacho.or.jp/shrine/%e6%af%94%e8%87%aa%e5%b2%90%e7%a5%9e%e7%a4%be/|access-date=2025-12-2}}</ref>.
